summary: Jiang Minghui presented the production experience and performance benefits of using MOQ (Quick Media Optimization) in Alibaba Group's real-time communication scenarios, such as top-of-voice search, cloud rendering, and AI assistance. While initial comparisons showed significant latency reductions compared to WebRTC, the speaker highlighted that transport-layer feedback alone is insufficient for optimal quality adaptation, motivating the development of an application-layer feedback mechanism to dynamically adjust media rates based on network conditions.
